defaults.tagline: Get paid before April even starts.
defaults.heroSubtext: Tax prep plus same-week refund advances up to $7,500. Holiday advances with zero Flux fee. No waiting room energy.
defaults.aboutTitle: Tax season, but make it this week.
defaults.about:
Flux is built for people who need the refund now — not a brochure and a callback. We file the return, size Holiday or Shield advances off the finished file, and text you when the money moves.

No hold music. No beige lobby. You sit with one person who already knows the product.
defaults.missionStatement: Fast is not sloppy. We do not quote an advance until the return is real.
defaults.servicesSectionSubtitle: File it. Fund it. Send a friend.

services.title: Prep + refund advance
services.description: We finish the return, then push Holiday or Shield funds — often the same day, always the same week when the file is clean.

faqs.question: Do I have to take the advance?
faqs.answer: No. File and wait if you want. We only size an advance after the return is done.

faqs.question: How fast is fast?
faqs.answer: Clean files: 30 minutes to 48 hours. Messy files take longer because we will not guess.

faqs.question: What do I bring?
faqs.answer: ID, Socials, W-2s or pay stubs, dependent docs. We text the list when you book.

faqs.question: Holiday vs Shield?
faqs.answer: Holiday: no Flux fee, smaller. Shield: $500–$7,500, bank fees shown before you tap yes.
